name: FPP Pushover Notifications
author: Juan Melendrez
description: Tracks RemoteFalcon song selections and main show start/end events, with configurable event settings, local Pushover credentials, a test-notification tool, a dashboard, and duplicate-suppressed event tracking.

privacy.summary: The plugin stores local notification preferences, Pushover credentials, and detected RemoteFalcon song selections and main show start/end events. The configuration page can send a test notification to Pushover. Automatic event-triggered notifications are not yet enabled.

sends.what: Test notification message and Pushover authentication credentials
sends.when: Only when the operator clicks Send Test Notification
sends.purpose: Verify Pushover credentials and HTTPS connectivity

collects.what: Local event history and notification preferences
Pushover User Key and API Token

privacy.other: Pushover credentials are stored in the local FPP plugin configuration file and are not displayed back in the web interface. The test action sends one HTTPS request to api.pushover.net. No automatic event notifications are sent in this milestone.
